scope: User-authorized replacement of row 4 with a quiet affectionate five-frame sequence; all other atlas pixels inherit the previously approved visual QA through preservation.json.

inspection_method.method: Inspected the original-size 192x208 frames in order on both light and dark backgrounds, including idle -> five row-4 frames -> idle and the row-4 wrap from frame 4 back to frame 0. This was frame-by-frame visual QA, not live browser or desktop playback.

semantic_authorization.new_behavior: quiet affectionate motion: slight head tilt, closed-eye smile, and recovery
semantic_authorization.note: The user explicitly authorized this semantic replacement and did not require a jump.

visual_evidence.identity: pass: the same horned skull headdress, white hair, green cloak, face, clothing, boots, gloves, and scroll are preserved in all five frames.
visual_evidence.head_and_face: pass: frame 1 introduces a restrained head tilt, frame 2 shows a closed-eye smile, and frames 3-4 recover naturally without facial deformation or identity drift.
visual_evidence.baseline_and_scale: pass: every row-4 frame ends at alpha bbox y=203; top bounds vary only from y=5 to y=7. Bbox widths vary from 156 to 157 pixels, with no visible size pop against idle.
visual_evidence.feet: pass: both boots remain planted on the same baseline with no sliding, cropping, or floating.
visual_evidence.scroll_and_hands: pass: the scroll stays attached to both hands with stable height, size, and angle; no teleport or prop-side change is visible.
visual_evidence.internal_loop: pass: frame 4 returns smoothly to frame 0; the repeated first frame shows no conspicuous snap.
visual_evidence.idle_transition: pass: idle -> frame 0 and frame 4 -> idle preserve practical scale, baseline, silhouette, and prop placement. The alpha center changes from idle (94.74,111.64) to row-4 endpoints (94.37,110.29) and (94.84,111.02), which is visually negligible.
visual_evidence.transparency_and_clipping: pass: light/dark background review shows no cropped foreground, opaque panel, accidental transparent body hole, seam, or detached/floating pixel cluster. Deterministic row QA reports zero edge pixels and zero chroma-adjacent pixels for all five frames.
visual_evidence.contact_sheet: pass: row 4 reads as a cohesive calm affectionate sequence within the full 8x11 atlas and remains proportionally consistent with idle and the unchanged rows.

preservation.effect: The prior approval of the other eight standard states and all sixteen look directions remains valid.

limitations: The animated files were assessed through their ordered source frames and timing metadata rather than a live Codex renderer, browser, or desktop playback session.
Only row 4 and its idle boundaries were re-reviewed visually; preservation.json establishes exact RGBA identity outside row 4, so unchanged rows and direction evidence were not redundantly re-tested.
